source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.3 with Examples 11.1 to 11.3 (PDF 253-255 and 257-258).

blocks.text: Theory of relativity is se mutalliq hai ke nisbati harkat ki mukhtalif halaton wale observers tabai mazahir ko kaise bayan karte hain. Special theory of relativity inertial (be-acceleration) frames of reference wale masail se mutalliq hai. Ek aur nazariya, general theory of relativity, aise frames se mutalliq hai jo ek doosre ke nisbat tez ho rahe hon. Special theory do postulates par mabni hai:

items: Physics ke qawaneen tamam inertial frames mein ek hain (principle of relativity).
Khali space mein light ki speed tamam observers ke liye ek hi qeemat rakhti hai, source ya observer ki harkat ki halat se qata-e-nazar (principle of constancy of light).

blocks.text: Pehla postulate is haqeeqat ko aam karta hai ke ek doosre ke nisbat yaksan velocity se chalte frames mein tamam tabai qawaneen ek hain. Agar nisbati harkat wale observers ke liye physics ke qawaneen mukhtalif hote to woh maloom kar sakte ke kaun saakin hai aur kaun chal raha hai; aisa koi farq nahi, to mutlaq yaksan harkat pakarne ka koi tareeqa nahi. Doosra postulate yeh tajrubati haqeeqat bayan karta hai ke khali space mein light ki speed aalami constant hai, c = 3 x 10^8 m s^-1; torch ki light ki speed v speed se chalti gari wala aur sarak par khara shakhs dono ek hi napte hain (Do You Know).

Chunke c mustaqil hai, space aur time nisbati ho jate hain. Maslan agar aap light ki speed ke qareeb (print mein 'light ki speed par') chalti train mein baithe hon aur bazu ki lambai par aaina pakren to bhi apna aks dekhenge, kyunke principle of relativity ke mutabiq koi tajruba andar baithe shakhs ke nisbat train ki mustaqil harkat nahi pakar sakta. Yeh saada postulates door-raas nataij rakhte hain, jaise saakin observer ko chalte frames mein ghariyon ka dheema chalna aur lambaiyon ka sukarna.

Agar ek observer mukhtalif jagahon ke do waqiaat ko ek saath (simultaneous) dekhe to pehle ke nisbat chalte doosre frame ka observer aam taur par unhein ek saath nahi dekhega. Aisi train lein jis ke darwaze roshni se khulte hain aur light ka switch chhat ke beech mein hai, jise dabbe ke beech khara musafir chalata hai. Jab train light ki aadhi speed se chal rahi ho, musafir light on karta hai. Roshni aage aur peeche barabar speed se chal kar dono darwazon tak ek saath pohanchti hai, to musafir dono darwaze ek saath khulte dekhta hai. Magar train ke bahar ka observer pichhla darwaza agle se pehle khulte dekhta hai, kyunke pichhla darwaza roshni ki taraf aa raha hai jabke agla roshni se door ja raha hai. Agar aap mustaqil velocity se chalte aise frame mein hon jahan se koi aur frame nazar na aaye, to jaanne ka koi tareeqa nahi ke aap chal rahe hain ya aaram mein (Interesting Information).

Special theory of relativity ke mutabiq time mutlaq miqdar nahi; yeh frame of reference ki harkat par munhasir hai. Maan lein inertial frame mein saakin observer usi frame ke do waqiaat ka darmiyani waqfa t0 napta hai; yeh proper time hai. Agar observer waqiaat ke frame ke nisbat relativistic velocity v se chale, ya waqiaat ka frame observer ke nisbat chale, to napa gaya waqt t0 nahi balke t = t0/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) ... (11.1) hai. Chunke sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) hamesha ek se kam hai, t, t0 se bara hai: nisbati harkat se waqt phail jata hai. Yeh tamam waqt ke amal, tabai, kimiyai aur hayatiyati, par lagu hai; relativistic speeds par insani jism ki umar barhne ka amal bhi dheema hota hai. Maslan 0.8c par urte jahaz mein musafir apne hisab se ek second mein kitab kholta hai, to jahaz ke bahar khare shakhs ke liye yahi waqiya 1.7 s leta hai.

Chalte spaceship ka observer Zameen se kisi sitare ka faasla Zameen ke observer ke muqable kam napega. Agar aap muqarrar faasle wale do nuqton ke nisbat chal rahe hon to un ka darmiyani faasla us se kam lagta hai jo aaram mein hone par lagta; yeh length contraction hai. Yeh sirf harkat ki simt mein hota hai; amudi simt mein koi sukarna nahi. Cheez ke nisbat aaram mein observer ki napi lambai proper length l0 hai. Agar cheez aur observer nisbati speed v se chal rahe hon to sukri hui lambai l = l0 sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) ... (11.2) hai. Aaram mein 100 m lambi train 0.8c par chale to andar wale ke liye phir bhi 100 m hai, magar patri ke kinare khara shakhs sirf 60 m napta hai.

Special theory of relativity ke mutabiq cheez ka mass us ki speed par munhasir hai. Aaram mein napa mass m0 (rest mass) wali cheez speed v se chalte hue barha hua mass m dikhati hai: m = m0/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) ... (11.3). Mass ka izafa tez speeds par jumood ka izafa hai: jaise v, c ke qareeb aata hai, speed badalne ke liye zyada force chahiye. Jab v, c ki taraf jaye to v/c, 1 ki taraf aur sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) sifar ki taraf jata hai, to m la-mehdood ho jata hai. La-mehdood mass ko tez karne ke liye la-mehdood force chahiye; chunke la-mehdood forces maujood nahi, koi maddi cheez khali space mein light ki speed tak tez nahi ki ja sakti.

Rozmarra zindagi mein hum light ki speed ke muqable intehai kam speeds se waasta rakhte hain; Zameen ki madari speed bhi sirf 30 km s^-1 hai jabke light 300 000 km s^-1 se chalti hai. Isi liye Newton ke qawaneen rozmarra halaat mein durust hain. Light ki speed ke qareeb chalte subatomic zarron ke liye relativistic asraat bohat numayan ho jate hain, aur tajrubati nataij Einstein ki equations ke baghair samjhaye nahi ja sakte.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: v/c ke muqable graphs, ek us factor ka jis se waqt aur mass barhte hain, jo c ki taraf tezi se uthta aur 0.8c par 1.67 hai, aur ek us factor ka jis se lambai sukarti hai, 0.8c par 0.6. Oopar daen: time dilation, length contraction, mass ki tabdeeli aur mass-energy ke formulae, Examples 11.1 se 11.3 ke saath. Neeche baen: bhaari gend ke gird mura hua jaal. Neeche daen: Suraj ke paas se guzarti sitare ki roshni murti hai aur sitara khiska hua nazar aata hai.
blocks.caption: Special relativity ke nataij, mass-energy aur kham-daar space-time (Figure 11.2 aur topics 11.3 se 11.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Rozmarra speeds par relativistic factors taqreeban bilkul ek hain, magar jaise speed light ki speed ke qareeb aati hai, ek taqseem jazr (square root) ek minus v murabba bata c murabba ka factor be-had barhta hai: chalti ghari is factor se dheemi, chalta mass is se zyada, aur chalti lambai is ke ulat se chhoti nazar aati hai; 0.8c par factors 1.67 aur 0.6 hain. Energy aur mass E barabar m c murabba se jure hain. Einstein ki tasveer mein bhaari jism space-time ko khinchi chadar par bhaari gend ki tarah morta hai, aur jism aur roshni in khamon par chalte hain; Suraj ke paas se guzarti sitare ki roshni murti hai, to sitara thora khiska nazar aata hai, jaisa 1919 ke grahan mein napa gaya.

blocks.title: Example 11.1
blocks.text: Pendulum ka period us ke apne inertial frame mein 3.0 s napa gaya. Pendulum ke nisbat 0.95c se chalte observer ko us ka period kitna milega? Hal: t0 = 3.0 s, v = 0.95c. t = t0/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) = 3.0 s/sqrt(1 - (0.95)^2) = 9.6 s.

blocks.title: Example 11.2
blocks.text: x-axis par rakhi 1.0 m lambi chhar saakin observer ke nisbat 0.75c se chal rahi hai. Saakin observer us ki lambai kitni napega? Hal: l0 = 1.0 m, v = 0.75c. l = l0 sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) = 1.0 m x sqrt(1 - (0.75)^2) = 0.66 m.

blocks.title: Example 11.3
blocks.text: 0.8c speed se chalti cheez ka mass m nikalein. Hal: m = m0/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) = m0/sqrt(1 - (0.8)^2) = 1.67 m0.

blocks.prompt: Maddi zarre ka light ki speed se chalna na-mumkin kyun hai (short question 11.3)? Ek electron 500 m lambi khali tube se 0.995c par guzarta hai; electron ko tube kitni lambi lagti hai (numerical 11.1)? Ausatan 20 min jeene wala neutron 0.8c par chalta hai; woh kitni der maujood lagta hai (numerical 11.2)?
blocks.explanation: Jaise v, c ke qareeb aata hai, m = m0/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) be-had barhta hai, to speed ke har mazeed izafe ke liye bari se bari force chahiye; c tak pohanchne ke liye la-mehdood force aur energy chahiye. l = 500 x sqrt(1 - 0.995^2) = 500 x 0.0999 = 50 m. t = 20/sqrt(1 - 0.64) = 20/0.6 = 33.3 min.

blocks.prompt: Aaram mein 100 m lamba spaceship observer ke paas se 0.99c par guzarta hai; observer kitni lambai napta hai (numerical 11.3)? Proton ka mass kis speed par teen guna hoga (numerical 11.6)? 0.5 kg ki gend (farzi taur par) 0.9c par phenki jaye; urte hue us ka mass kya hai (numerical 11.8)?

items: Special relativity inertial frames se mutalliq hai (general relativity tez hote frames se). Postulates: (1) physics ke qawaneen tamam inertial frames mein ek; (2) khali space mein light ki speed, c = 3 x 10^8 m s^-1, tamam observers ke liye ek. Nateeja: space aur time nisbati.

Simultaneity nisbati hai (roshni se khulne wale darwazon wali train). Time dilation t = t0/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) (11.1); harkat ki simt mein length contraction l = l0 sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) (11.2); mass m = m0/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2) (11.3), is liye koi maddi cheez c tak nahi pohanchti. Misalein: 9.6 s; 0.66 m; 1.67 m0.
